_comment: ATOS AI layer config. See docs/atos_ai_implementation_plan.md and docs/atos_ai_tracker.md. Ships fully OFF. Changes take effect on the next scan cycle (config is read fresh each call).
_enabled_sim_comment: Turn on AI observe+log for the SIM account (paper). Free by itself -- just writes trade proposals to data/ai_trade_proposals.jsonl.
_enabled_ai_sim_comment: AI-DECISION SIM TWIN (2026-09-03). forex/runner.py --account ai_sim + atos_ai_stocks.py -- a SIM PAPER book (no real orders anywhere) where the Trading Copilot's resize/skip IS applied and the basket-ranker's re-ranked pick IS traded. A live forward A/B vs the deterministic SIM books, on ai_dashboard.py. Own ledgers (forex_ai / stock_ai). Not gated by shadow_mode -- acting is the twin's whole purpose; shadow_mode('ai_sim') is hardcoded False. Needs agent_enabled (a paid call per signal, evaluated every rescan not deduped). This is the test bed for the future 'AI runs ATOS by itself' plan -- weeks of SIM evidence before any LIVE-autonomy decision (its own written go/no-go; LIVE stays out of _AI_ACTING_ACCOUNTS until then).
_enabled_live_shadow_comment: Turn on AI observe+log for the REAL LIVE accounts (live = SEK, live_eur = EUR). LOG ONLY -- the agent's decision is recorded next to the real trade, never applied. AI physically cannot change a LIVE order: 'live'/'live_eur' are not in ai/config.py's _AI_ACTING_ACCOUNTS, so can_apply_decision() is always False for them regardless of this file. Use this to check whether the AI's calls line up with the real winners/losers before spending more.
_shadow_mode_comment: SIM only. true = every AI hook still only OBSERVES and LOGS. A later sprint flips this to false (SIM sizing), gated on its own shadow-evidence review. Has no effect on LIVE (LIVE is always shadow).
_agent_comment: enabled_sim / enabled_live_shadow alone just LOG trade proposals (free). agent_enabled=true additionally calls the LLM (agent_model) to evaluate each proposal -- costs money per signal, needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. The decision is still only LOGGED until Sprint 4 (SIM only).
_agent_model_comment: claude-sonnet-5 for the shadow study (~5x cheaper per token than opus). Switch to claude-opus-5 if Sonnet's calls look weak in ai_shadow_report.py.
_cost_controls_comment: agent_strategies: which strategies the paid agent evaluates -- ['*'] for all, or a list. 2026-09-02: set to the 5-strategy SIM roster (SIM_ACTIVE_STRATEGIES in forex/runner.py) -- the user wants the AI watching all of them for a few weeks before deciding which to keep. Proposal-logging + the Journal already cover EVERY strategy for free; this list only scopes the PAID copilot evaluation. `rsi` fires a lot (unfiltered/184 pairs); the 4 gated twins fire far less. Deduped daily. agent_dedup: evaluate each signal (account|strategy|symbol|date) ONCE per day, not every 30-min rescan.
_journal_comment: AI Trading Journal (roadmap #18): an LLM retrospective on each CLOSED trade (entry/exit quality, why it won/lost, the lesson) + a daily pattern summary. READ-ONLY -- ai/features/trade_journal.py only reads closed-trade logs (observation cards, AI shadow decisions, exit-advisor shadow) and writes data/ai_trade_journal.jsonl. It never places/amends/cancels an order, never touches a position or stop, never influences a strategy or sizing decision. Cost: ONE batched LLM call per trading day (not per trade). Runs from daily_summary.py; also `python ai_trade_journal.py`.
_stocks_comment: Stocks AI layer (2026-09-02): the forex AI layer extended to the SIM stocks module (atos_runner.py). ARMED 2026-09-02 (enabled:true) -- still OBSERVE/LOG only (no apply path in the code). Sub-flags: journal = feed stocks closed trades to the AI Journal (cheap); shadow_copilot_reversion = score every US Reversion entry (log-only); shadow_copilot_signals = score every US Signals entry (SMA Crossover / RSI Reversal / Momentum / Ensemble) with the shadow Copilot (log-only, false until ~40 signal trades accumulated); basket_ranker_blend = shadow-rank the US Blend fortnightly offense basket (one LLM call per rebalance, log-only). Reports: ai_trade_journal.py --report, report_ai_basket.py. IBKR strategies (ibkr_executor.py) also log observation cards to stock_observation_cards.jsonl (account_env=ibkr_paper, native_currency=USD) under the same enabled gate. Set enabled:false to disarm the whole subtree next cycle. See docs/atos_ai_tracker.md.
_stocks_live_comment: REAL-MONEY US Blend sleeve (atos_live_stocks.py, SEK LIVE sub-account, 30k SEK, Phase 1 = observe-only). Its OWN block so it toggles independently of the SIM `stocks` study. Same OBSERVE/LOG-only contract: can_apply_decision('live_stocks') is False in code forever ('live_stocks' is not in ai/config.py's _AI_ACTING_ACCOUNTS). ARMED 2026-09-02 -- the user asked ATOS AI to record and learn from every LIVE stocks trade from day one. journal = feed LIVE stocks closed trades to the AI Journal (weighed heavier -- real money); basket_ranker_blend = shadow-rank the US Blend fortnightly offense basket (one LLM call per rebalance, log-only). No shadow_copilot_reversion -- the LIVE sleeve trades US Blend only. Reports: ai_trade_journal.py --report, report_ai_basket.py.
_stocks_ai_comment: AI-decision stocks twin (atos_ai_stocks.py, account_env 'ai_sim'). SIM paper US Blend book that TRADES the basket-ranker's re-ranked pick (ai_offense[:ai_count]) instead of the deterministic top-N -- ai/config.basket_ranker_applies('ai_sim') is the only True. Own DB data/atos_ai.db. journal feeds its closed trades to the AI Journal.
_outcome_predictor_comment: Trade Outcome Predictor (2026-09-03, roadmap #20): ai/models/trade_outcome_predictor.py. GradientBoosting classifier trained on our real closed observation cards (entry context features + r_multiple label) to predict whether a new entry will be profitable. Replaces the CNN-LSTM's raw price-direction approach with direct trade-profitability prediction using features logged at entry time: regime, RSI, ADX, strategy, ATR%, spread-cost ratio, pair historical WR. Gate: 100 closed non-orphaned cards needed before training (data accumulating from 2026-09-01). enabled: true wires top_win_prob into every proposal the Copilot sees. Ships OFF until gate clears. Retrain: python ai_outcome_predictor.py --train (weekly).
_research_analyst_comment: AI Research Analyst (2026-09-03, roadmap #19): ai/features/research_analyst.py. OFFLINE + READ-ONLY. Aggregates the closed-trade record + the AI Trading Journal + a decomposition harness (ai/research/decompose.py, replays each strategy's REAL generate_signals over ~13y of Yahoo daily bars) into a digest, has an LLM propose SPECIFIED, testable entry/exit/sizing filters, auto-runs the cheap decomposition gate on each (positive in both halves + bootstrap CI excludes zero), and keeps a triaged backlog in data/ai_research_hypotheses.jsonl. It NEVER edits a strategy or touches an order -- a human reads a hypothesis, writes the deterministic gate, and forward-tests it as an isolated SIM A/B twin (the same process that produced the current 5-strategy roster). Ships OFF. `python ai_research_analyst.py [--sweep|--report|--digest]`. sweep_years = decomposition replay lookback; max_hypotheses_per_run = LLM cap.
_stock_outcome_predictor_comment: Stock Trade Outcome Predictor (2026-09-03, roadmap #20 sibling): ai/models/stock_outcome_predictor.py. GradientBoosting classifier trained on data/stock_observation_cards.jsonl (entry context + r_multiple label) to predict whether a new US stock entry will be profitable. Sibling of the forex TOP. Features: rsi14, stop_pct, target_pct, risk_reward, daily_vol_pct, regime, adx, ticker_win_rate, day_of_week. Gate: 50 closed non-orphaned stock trades (accumulating from 2026-09-03). enabled:true wires stock_top_win_prob into every stock proposal. Ships OFF until gate clears. Retrain: python ai_stock_outcome_predictor.py --train (daily at 22:00 PKT).
_exit_copilot_comment: Phase C — AI exit timing agent (ai/agent/exit_copilot.py). Evaluates open SIM positions that have reached ≥min_mfe_r profit (default 1.0R) and decides HOLD or EXIT_NOW. Runs in the _run_exits pass after the deterministic exit_advisor. Ships SHADOW-ONLY (shadow_mode:true) — logs every decision to data/ai_exit_decisions.jsonl with est_pnl_eur_at_decision so report_phase_c_counterfactual.py can measure give-back saved vs actual exit. Flip shadow_mode:false only after Phase B proves out (3 weeks SIM A/B). LIVE is never in the apply path. Deduped once per position per day.
_exposure_controller_comment: Phase A — portfolio-level exposure controller (ai/portfolio/exposure_controller.py). Runs BEFORE the Trading Copilot on every entry signal; blocks trades that breach the cluster/pair/risk-pct caps and logs to data/exposure_controller.jsonl. Defaults are permissive for the first week of observation — tighten after the gate passes (see docs/atos_ai_tracker.md Phase A gate). max_currency_cluster_positions: max open positions net-long or net-short any one currency. max_open_risk_pct_equity: total open risk (sum of risk_eur_at_entry) as % of account equity. max_same_pair_positions: max open positions for the same 6-char symbol across all strategies.
